source_instruction: i need a futon set that is blue velvet
query:
I just got back from walking my neighbor’s goofy golden retriever, Muffin, who decided halfway through the route that every single fire hydrant on Oak Street required a full two-minute snuffle investigation, plus she stopped to beg a whole cheese stick from the food cart guy by the laundromat before we even made it to the park. By the time we looped back to her place, my socks were soaked through from stepping in that weird puddle that always forms by the cracked sidewalk by the library, and she’d slobbered all over the cuff of my favorite canvas jacket so bad I had to scrub it in her kitchen sink before I headed out. I swear that dog could charm a squirrel out of its acorn stash, though, because she gave me that big dopey grin when I left and pressed her favorite slobbery tennis ball into my hand as a thank you, so I can’t even be mad about the wet socks or the slobber.
Hey there, I’m browsing the beds section right now and need to find a nice blue velvet piece for my bathroom that works for the space, plus it should come with a matching detachable storage ottoman. I don’t want to go over four bills, right? Wait, no, actually the max I’m comfortable shelling out is a note—you know, the standard amount people usually mean when they say that for mid-range bedroom furniture? Let me know what options you have that check all those boxes for me.
